content:
{"ranking": [
{"id": "P04", "why": "Opens with Juliana physically shielding Alexander and a shouted denial — instant visual conflict and clear stakes; the strongest premise hook in the set, no policy risk, sets the slate’s tone."},
{"id": "P07", "why": "A bearded stranger’s command ‘Take your hands off her’ delivers a rescue hook that stops scroll; mild flag but the opening power and proposal cliffhanger make it a top‑tier premise."},
{"id": "P09", "why": "‘The Duchess is dying’ followed by Juliana’s claim she can save her gives immediate life‑or‑death urgency; clean premise, high hook and cliffhanger scores, no policy issue."},
{"id": "P22", "why": "‘This man is an imposter! Arrest him!’ launches with a public accusation and Alexander’s icy composure; strongest cold‑open among premises, spreads episode range."},
{"id": "P15", "why": "Juliana’s frantic ‘Alexander!’ cries create a clear rescue arc; sharp trapped‑exit cliffhanger and solid standalone clarity keep new viewers oriented."},
{"id": "P25", "why": "Cruel insult ‘worthless as everyone thinks you are’ hooks with humiliation; vow ending adds romantic tension, good emotional charge for the female audience."},
{"id": "P28", "why": "Child‑dying plea ‘Toby is dying!’ grabs empathy instantly; Juliana’s decisive ‘We go now’ gives agency, though cliffhanger is softer."},
{"id": "P33", "why": "Visual scar reveal after ‘Alexander!’ offers a visceral hook; mild policy flag and draggy middle lower it, but still a clear premise beat."},
{"id": "P41", "why": "Former groom’s rejection ‘You are far too plain’ is a classic humiliation hook; however the clip resolves into pity without forward tension, so placed lower."},
{"id": "P43", "why": "Juliana entering a barren cottage sets the premise but opens on a slow, soft beat; low hook score makes it a later premise filler."},
{"id": "P47", "why": "Physical grab and bloody reveal give a strong hook, yet the clip talks too long before the peak; mild flag and low overall keep it at the premise tail."},
{"id": "P01", "why": "Mother’s legacy threatened and burned — cruel, tight, cuts on the perfect threat; highest overall score, mid‑arc but works as a powerful early payoff."},
{"id": "P02", "why": "Opens on a scream and ends with a branding iron millimeters from an eye — maximal hook and cliffhanger, pure payoff adrenaline."},
{"id": "P03", "why": "Cathedral doors burst open, bishop and armed officer interrupt; cuts at the moment of maximum danger, high stakes, clear standalone."},
{"id": "P05", "why": "Alexander’s ‘let them believe I’m dead’ shock front‑loads the twist; villains’ murder plot cliffhanger drives want‑next, tight two‑hander."},
{"id": "P06", "why": "Explosive cathedral entrance detonation hooks visually; cliffhanger ‘Because we know who he is’ delivers identity reveal tease; mild flag but top‑tier impact."},
{"id": "P08", "why": "Frame‑up revealed at peak — constable hurls linens, Gerald finds planted evidence; devastating hook and cliffhanger, mild flag only."},
{"id": "P11", "why": "Opens with a slap and closes with villains gloating over a wedding‑execution deadline; strongest scroll‑stopper in the payoff tier."},
{"id": "P12", "why": "Judge’s verdict threat ‘Lady Juliana Ashcroft…’ cuts at the refusal‑to‑verdict peak; slow open but the run makes it the strongest ad per judge."},
{"id": "P13", "why": "‘You swore you loved me!’ / ‘People change their minds’ — instantly legible betrayal hook, sharp unanswered verbal cliffhanger, no policy risk."},
{"id": "P14", "why": "Catherine yanks locket, calls Juliana ‘gutter rat’ — brutal humiliation hook, clear underdog stakes; mild flag but high emotional charge."},
{"id": "P16", "why": "Alexander’s rage ‘The ambush was not an accident’ hooks with accusation; clear stakes, though mid‑ad reset softens cliffhanger."},
{"id": "P17", "why": "Public wedding presentation then ten‑day deadline from High Priest; clear stakes and strong deadline cliffhanger, hook lands just after 3s."},
{"id": "P18", "why": "‘You could have lost your hands’ / ‘But I didn’t lose you’ — shocking line hook, vengeance fist cliffhanger; mild flag but tight emotional arc."},
{"id": "P19", "why": "Immediate shove and cry ‘Ah!’ — violence hook, unanswered fight challenge cliffhanger; most scroll‑stopping mid‑arc, mild flag."},
{"id": "P20", "why": "Dying child emergency escalates to branding iron at eye — best peak in batch, high hook and cliffhanger; mild flag but peak power wins."},
{"id": "P21", "why": "Dowager Duchess’s ring reveal ‘Where did you get this ring?’ — slow build but shocking grab cliffhanger demands next episode."},
{"id": "P23", "why": "Alexander’s cruel ‘Throw her past the perimeter!’ and Juliana’s dominating ultimatum; strong command hook, slightly overlong."},
{"id": "P24", "why": "Conspiratorial setup ‘She will hang’ paired with visual torture cliffhanger; only clip with both, mild flag but high emotion."},
{"id": "P26", "why": "Legacy insult hook redeemed by sharp threat ending ‘Choose your next words carefully’; slower start but strong want‑next."},
{"id": "P27", "why": "Visceral mid‑action clawing and bloodied ring grab — instant hook, sacrifices setup; mild flag but punchy for variety."},
{"id": "P29", "why": "Scorched parchment and chained Juliana — brutal high‑impact open; overlong deflated finish lowers cliffhanger, mild flag."},
{"id": "P30", "why": "Riding crop strike hook is brutal; soft talky ending ‘Let her believe I am ignorant’ wastes tension, mild flag."},
{"id": "P31", "why": "‘That is witchcraft’ / ‘She saved Toby!’ — clear coercion hook; fading reactive ending ‘Save your tears for the trial’ limits cliffhanger."},
{"id": "P32", "why": "Mother’s frail touch then Guard Captain salute ‘He is your Duke’ — crystal stakes, emotional reunion plus public vindication."},
{"id": "P34", "why": "Treason hook ‘crowned priest conspired’ strong; soft romantic hand‑clasp ending ruins cliffhanger, still clear standalone."},
{"id": "P35", "why": "Gerald’s ‘scarred beggar’ insult hooks; resolves too early with departure line, low cliffhanger for a mid‑arc."},
{"id": "P36", "why": "Catherine’s feigned grief ‘I thought you had died’ slow start; ends on devastating ‘Her?!’ twist demanding next episode."},
{"id": "P37", "why": "Catherine/Father Thomas conspiracy talk — scandal hook but sags into talky midpoint; lower hook and cliffhanger scores."},
{"id": "P38", "why": "‘Because she was dying!’ conflict hook; long talky middle and reactive ending ‘That is not what I said!’ undercut."},
{"id": "P39", "why": "Juliana’s defiance ‘They think hunger will make me surrender’ — visceral protagonist, but cliffhanger replaced by moment of grace."},
{"id": "P40", "why": "Legal stakes ‘Duke’s marriage judged by Crown’ and ticking clock; villain threat ‘Ten days is plenty’ — strongest ad per judge, mild flag."},
{"id": "P42", "why": "Thug club caught bare‑hand — best cold open; resolves mystery on screen instead of cutting before answer, mild flag."},
{"id": "P44", "why": "Alexander’s determined ‘bringing my wife home’ — polished but slow‑burn, lacks immediate hook or sharp cliffhanger."},
{"id": "P45", "why": "Talky opening ‘gossip becomes dangerous’; strong villain paranoia back half but disjointed cut loses scrollers early."},
{"id": "P46", "why": "Slow villain monologue builds to death threat ‘witch will be dead’; takes too long to hook, low overall."},
{"id": "P48", "why": "Church bells realization hook needs seconds to land; disjointed rescue action payoff, mild flag, lowest in payoff tier."}
]}
